title: YouTube Video & Audio Downloader
description: Download one video or audio file. Pay through Apify per completed MB; no FlashData API key or cloud storage credentials required.

url.title: YouTube video URL
url.description: Public YouTube watch, Shorts or youtu.be HTTPS URL.

download_type.title: Download Type
download_type.description: Video with audio, video only, or audio only.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: Video: mp4, webm, mkv. Audio: m4a, mp3, opus. Omit to use the type-specific default.

video_quality.title: Video Quality
video_quality.description: Default ceiling: 1080p. Up to 2160p where available. Omit for audio-only downloads; no upscaling.

fps.title: Fps
fps.description: Frame-rate constraint. Omit for audio-only downloads.

audio_quality.title: Audio Quality
audio_quality.description: Applies only to audio downloads; omit for video or combined media.

audio_language.title: Audio Language
audio_language.description: Audio language selection; omit for video-only downloads.

maxFileMB.title: Maximum file size (MB)
maxFileMB.description: Hard file-size ceiling. Also limited by your run budget. 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes. Oversized downloads fail without a download event charge.
